improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Instant AI answers for business owners, traders, and professionals. Voice chat, unlimited workspace, and expert trade support. Start with three free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://gdn.ai/og-image.png">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://gdn.ai">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value proposition and free trial offer within the 155-character limit. Open Graph tags ensure professional, consistent previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the pricing anchor and free searches creates urgency without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three searches free — no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: This copy immediately introduces Gideon by name, clearly states what it does (AI trade and business assistant), and highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support). The subheading removes friction by emphasizing the free trial with no commitment, which increases conversion likelihood. The tone is confident and direct without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing unlimited AI-powered trade and business support. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, with flexible monthly or annual billing options—annual plans save you 30 percent. As a member, you'll unlock voice chat, an unlimited workspace, and professional-grade assistance whenever you need it.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the primary conversion point—the paywall moment. By clearly explaining what happens next and immediately reinforcing the low entry price and value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), it reduces friction and anxiety at the critical decision point, encouraging visitors to convert rather than abandon.
